annotations.bnjettag.io/purpose: pilot-program CPU gate: threshold, cpu_gate.py on 24 configs, NB pairing, full pytest; fail-fast, last line GATE_RESULT

args:
set -euo pipefail
trap 'rc=$?; if [ -z "${GATE_RESULT_PRINTED:-}" ]; then echo "GATE_RESULT FAIL exit=$rc line=${LINENO}"; fi' EXIT
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '98dd2875b7c902bb881562a7acbf00f7cf266a369a74528b6fb8471e0cdc0059  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-program-20261005/r1 BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/pilot1005
export BNJ_STAGE=pilot-r1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 WANDB_MODE=disabled
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-cpu.txt
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "e6ff034bfc44580a44fc96a27fedcd302f43babbef70169e90802f4ea9a0a8e3" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
gate_fail() { GATE_RESULT_PRINTED=1; echo "GATE_RESULT FAIL $*"; exit 1; }
OUT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-program-20261005/cpu-gate-98dd28-r1
test ! -e "$OUT" || gate_fail "output_exists $OUT"
mkdir -p /data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-program-20261005 && mkdir "$OUT"
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || gate_fail "cache_not_ready"
pip install -q --no-cache-dir pytest==8.4.2
pip freeze > "$OUT/pip-freeze.txt"
TH=0; python -u /work/code/campaigns/pilot1005/nondegenerate_threshold.py --cache /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data --out "$OUT/threshold.json" > "$OUT/threshold.log" 2>&1 || TH=$?
test "$TH" = 0 || gate_fail "threshold_script exit=$TH"
python -u /work/code/campaigns/pilot1005/gate_check.py threshold --json "$OUT/threshold.json" || gate_fail "threshold_mismatch"
GATE=0; python -u /work/code/campaigns/pilot1005/cpu_gate.py --out "$OUT/cpu_gate.json" > "$OUT/cpu_gate.log" 2>&1 || GATE=$?
grep -E "PID_TRACED_ONLY_OK|PID_HISTORICAL_INPUT_OK|PAIRED_INIT_OK|PREFLIGHT_ALL_PASS|Error|assert" "$OUT/cpu_gate.log" | tail -n 60 || true
python -u /work/code/campaigns/pilot1005/gate_check.py cpu-gate --log "$OUT/cpu_gate.log" --exit-code "$GATE" || gate_fail "cpu_gate exit=$GATE"
NBP=0; python -u /work/code/campaigns/pilot1005/pair_nb.py --out "$OUT/nb_pairing.json" > "$OUT/nb_pairing.log" 2>&1 || NBP=$?
grep -E "^NB_" "$OUT/nb_pairing.log" || true
python -u /work/code/campaigns/pilot1005/gate_check.py nb-pairing --log "$OUT/nb_pairing.log" --exit-code "$NBP" || gate_fail "nb_pairing exit=$NBP"
PT=0; python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs --junitxml "$OUT/pytest.xml" tests analysis > "$OUT/pytest.log" 2>&1 || PT=$?
tail -n 30 "$OUT/pytest.log"
python -u /work/code/campaigns/pilot1005/gate_check.py pytest --junit "$OUT/pytest.xml" --exit-code "$PT" || gate_fail "pytest exit=$PT"
sha256sum "$OUT"/*
echo "CPU_GATE_DONE threshold_exit=$TH cpu_gate_exit=$GATE nb_pairing_exit=$NBP pytest_exit=$PT"
GATE_RESULT_PRINTED=1
echo "GATE_RESULT PASS"
containers.name: main
